changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionRelationship]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [SubjectUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, SubjectAssetID bigint null, SubjectAssetTypeID int null, [Subject] [varchar](50) NULL, [SubjectID] [int] NULL, [ObjectUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, ObjectAssetID bigint null, ObjectAssetTypeID int null, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [IntersectID] [int] NULL, [Owner] [nvarchar](100) NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [IsNew] [bit] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionRelationship] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'Owner') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionRelationship] ADD Owner [nvarchar](100) NULL END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectAssetID') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationship] add SubjectAssetID bigint null; end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectAssetTypeID') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationship] add SubjectAssetTypeID int null; end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectAssetID') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationship] add ObjectAssetID bigint null; end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectAssetTypeID') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationship] add ObjectAssetTypeID int null; end
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationship' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'Owner') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionRelationship] DROP COLUMN Owner END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_Uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_Uid] ON [api].[ExecutionRelationship] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Uid] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_ObjectUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_ObjectUid] ON [api].[ExecutionRelationship] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ObjectUid] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_SubjectUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_SubjectUid] ON [api].[ExecutionRelationship] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [SubjectUid] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_Success') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_Success] ON [api].[ExecutionRelationship] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Success] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_Uid') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_Uid] ON [api].[ExecutionRelationship] END
